Automatic theme matching

The game reads the page background and accent colors. Dark sites get a white paddle and electric ball; light sites get a dark paddle and a high-contrast accent ball.

01

Reads the page

Visible content blocks become the level. The page never leaves the visitor’s browser.

02

Matches the colors

Paddle, ball, outlines and HUD adapt automatically for contrast and character.

03

Starts on demand

Use the floating launcher, a playable link, or call PageBreaker.start().
